records.issue_text: Fallback locales are loaded only during controller requests, while the translation accelerator loads only config.locale, causing background jobs and mailers to incorrectly return “translation missing” when site or English fallback locales have not been loaded; load fallback locales in the translation path itself.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` within the ApplicationController (line 159), which is a controller callback. The `ensure_loaded!` method (defined in FallbackLocaleList class in config/initializers/i18n.rb) loads fallback locales by calling `I18n.ensure_loaded!` for each locale in the fallback chain. Background jobs and other code paths that call translations directly without going through controller actions would not trigger this loading.
